paragraphs.en: On the fifth day, the secret of the little prince's life was revealed to me through the sheep. Abruptly, he asked: "If a sheep eats little bushes, does it eat flowers too?"
paragraphs.zh: 第五天，小王子生活的秘密通过羊羔之口被揭示给我。他突然问道：“如果羊吃掉了灌木丛，会不会也把花一起吃了？”

paragraphs.en: I replied, "A sheep eats anything within reach."
paragraphs.zh: 我说：“羊吃得到的东西什么都吃。”

paragraphs.en: "Even thorny flowers?" he pressed.
paragraphs.zh: “刺人的花朵？”他脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: I admitted, "Yes, even those with thorns."
paragraphs.zh: 我承认，“是的，连带刺的也不例外。”

paragraphs.en: He questioned further, "Then what use are the thorns?"
paragraphs.zh: 他继续问道：“那这些刺还有什么用？”

paragraphs.en: Silently, I struggled to unscrew a stuck bolt in my engine. Worried about the serious breakdown and limited water supply, I barely noticed his question.
paragraphs.zh: 我默默地与卡住的螺栓作斗争，试图将其拧松。心中担忧发动机可能出现严重故障以及有限的淡水供应，几乎没有注意到他提出的问题。

paragraphs.en: The little prince persisted: "What use are the thorns?"
paragraphs.zh: 小王子坚持问道：“刺有什么用呢？”

paragraphs.en: I snapped, "Thorns are useless! Flowers have them just for spite!"
paragraphs.zh: 我脱口而出：“刺根本没用！花长刺纯粹是作对！”

paragraphs.en: He was silent for a moment before retorting with resentment, "I don't believe you. Flowers are weak and naive. They reassure themselves by thinking their thorns are weapons."
paragraphs.zh: 他沉默了一会儿，带着怨恨反驳道：“我不相信你。花朵柔弱天真，它们自欺欺人地认为自己的刺是武器。”

paragraphs.en: Unsure of how to respond, I focused on the bolt. He continued, "You actually believe that?"
paragraphs.zh: 犹豫着不知该如何回答，我把注意力集中在那颗螺栓上。他接着说：“你居然还相信？”

paragraphs.en: "No!" I exclaimed, "No, no! I was just saying what came to mind.
paragraphs.zh: “不！”我脱口而出，“不，不！我只是随口说的。”

paragraphs.en: I'm busy!"
paragraphs.zh: 我正忙呢！

paragraphs.en: He stared at me, exasperated: "Matters of consequence!"
paragraphs.zh: 他气恼地盯着我：“這可是大事！”

paragraphs.en: Pointing at my messy appearance and tools, he said, "You talk like the grown-ups—everything mixed up together."
paragraphs.zh: 指着我凌乱的外表和工具，他说道：“你说话像那些大人一样——一切都混在一起了。”

paragraphs.en: Ashamed but determined, I retorted, "I am dealing with important matters!"
paragraphs.zh: 羞愧但决心已定，我脱口而出：“我正在处理重要的事情！”

paragraphs.en: The little prince was furious. "I know a man who has never smelled a flower or looked at stars. He's just added up figures all his life, saying 'I am busy with matters of consequence!'
paragraphs.zh: 小王子气得火冒三丈。“我知道一个从未闻过花香、看过星星的人。他一生都在计算数字，嘴里还说着‘我正忙于重要的事情！’”

paragraphs.en: But he’s not a man—he’s a mushroom!"
paragraphs.zh: 但他不是人——他是个蘑菇！

paragraphs.en: "What kind of mushroom?"
paragraphs.zh: “什么蘑菇？”

paragraphs.en: "A mushroom!"
paragraphs.zh: “蘑菇！”

paragraphs.en: The little prince turned red. "Flowers have grown thorns for millions of years, and sheep eat them every day. Why haven't we tried to understand why flowers grow thorns?
paragraphs.zh: 小王子的脸红了。“花朵长刺的历史悠久，羊每天都在吃它们。我们为什么没有尝试去理解花朵为何会长刺呢？”

paragraphs.en: Is that unimportant? It's more important than the sums this man adds up all day."
paragraphs.zh: 这不重要？比他整天算的那些数字还要重要。

paragraphs.en: "If I know a flower unique on my planet, one little sheep could destroy it in an instant. If the sheep eats it, all my stars will be darkened! You think that’s not important?"
paragraphs.zh: “如果我那颗星球上有一种独一无二的花朵，一只羊就能在瞬间将其毁掉。如果羊吃了它，我的所有星辰都会熄灭！你认为这不重要吗？”

paragraphs.en: His face flushed as he continued, "If someone loves a flower from among millions of stars, just looking at those stars makes them happy. But if the sheep eats the flower, all his happiness is gone in an instant!"
paragraphs.zh: 他脸庞一红，继续说道：“如果一个人在无数星辰中爱上了一朵花，仅仅看看那些星星都会让他快乐。但如果羊吃掉了那朵花，他的快乐顿时烟消云散！”

paragraphs.en: Night fell, and I dropped my tools. My hammer, thirst, or death seemed unimportant now. There was a little prince on Earth to comfort.
paragraphs.zh: 夜幕降临，我放下手中的工具。此刻，锤子、口渴甚至死亡都显得不那么重要了，因为地球上有一个小王子需要安慰。

paragraphs.en: I held him close, rocking him gently.
paragraphs.zh: 我紧紧抱着他，轻轻摇晃着。

paragraphs.en: "I will draw you a muzzle for your sheep," I said, "and a railing around your flower. But what can I say to make it better?"
paragraphs.zh: “我给你羊圈装个笼头，”我说，“花坛围上栅栏。可我还得说点什么才能更完美呢？”

paragraphs.en: I felt awkward and unsure how to reach him or continue our journey together. Tears filled the land of our shared sorrow.
paragraphs.zh: 我感到局促不安，不确定该如何接近他或继续我们的旅程。悲伤的土地上泪光点点。
